messages:
Rae: quick design ask for Serving Wins launch assets. Need compact bundle for launch day: hero slide 1920x1080 (layered Figma), benchmark chart (cost vs latency) optimized for social, editable slide master, 3 social crops (1:1, 9:16, 16:9), email header, + 1-page SDR PDF. Include PNG + SVG exports and alt text. Deadline: Tue EOD for first pass. @Jon @Priya
Jon: got it. Please confirm: anonymized competitor clusters or named points? also need CSV for exact plotting.
Rae: anonymized clusters only. CSV in analytics sheet, granting view to design. Use simplified callouts: "Recommended config" + 2 metrics.
Priya: brand rules: Redwood Blue for primary, Ink for type. No gradients on charts; icons from brand set. Stacked logo for hero, horizontal for footer. I'll add swatches in Figma.
Sam: hero headline options: 1) "Serving wins: faster inference, lower cost." 2) "Ship LLM features faster with predictable latency." Use option 1 for hero, others for socials.
Ivy: UTMs please: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_wins_launch. HubSpot mapping: hs_lead_source="Webinar: Serving Wins", hs_campaign="serving_wins_launch", hs_tags="webinar_servingwins". I'll provision form and hidden fields.
LegalBot: need CSV provenance / API run IDs before approving any comparative claims. Will review by Tue noon.
Jon: ETA first comps Tue 5pm. I'll include export checklist (PNG@2x, SVG, PDF) and add alt text in Figma. File naming: servingwins_<asset>_<size>_v1.png.
Rae: perfect. Tag the sheet row "approved_for_publish" after Legal signs off. I'll coordinate reviews: Design -> Brand -> Legal -> Ops. Thanks! :thumbsup:
